Local AI suite

Studio-grade AI. Zero round trips to the cloud.

Every AI tool in Vista runs directly on your machine's hardware. That means your photos are never uploaded anywhere to get the magic — and there's no waiting on a server queue.

One click

Optimize Image

A single click reads the whole frame — skin tones, light falloff, contrast — and grades it like a colorist would. What took minutes of manual adjustment now takes a click, and you can always compare against the original before committing.

  • Balances exposure, tone and color in one pass
  • Built-in Compare view, side by side
  • Fully reversible, non-destructive
Before After
Background removal

Remove Background, cleanly

Fine hair, soft edges, busy backdrops — Vista's on-device segmentation handles the hard cases and hands you a clean cutout, ready to drop onto a new background or export with transparency.

  • One click, no manual masking
  • Exports with true transparency
  • Pairs with layers to composite new scenes
Before After
Magic Eraser

Click the object. Watch it disappear.

Select anything in the frame — a passerby, a stray cable, a whole second person — and Magic Eraser fills the space back in, reconstructing the background as if it was never there.

  • Click-to-select, then erase
  • Context-aware fill, not a blur patch
  • Works on people, objects and backgrounds
Portrait Bokeh

Lens-quality blur, no lens required

Pick your subject and Vista keeps it razor sharp while the background falls into a smooth, natural disc-blur — the look of a fast portrait lens, rendered entirely on-device.

  • Select any subject, not just faces
  • Natural, adjustable blur falloff
  • Great for phone photos shot at f/8

Full editing suite

When you want to go beyond one click

A complete canvas underneath the AI — crop, curves, layers, text and brand kits — for when a photo needs a human touch.

Live crop & canvas

1:1, 4:5, 9:16 and 16:9 presets, box select, click-to-select wand, pan, zoom and safe zones — with full undo history.

Curves & adjust

Full manual control over exposure, curves, HSL and sharpness whenever you want to push past the one-click result.

Looks

Original, black & white, warm and cool — starting points you can push further with the adjust panel.

Layers & blend modes

Stack edits non-destructively, control opacity and blending, and combine with Remove Background for full composites.

Text, logo & brand kit

Drop in your logo or watermark, add text templates, and keep a consistent brand kit across every export.

Recipes & batch

Save a crop, look and logo combo as a recipe, then apply it across a whole folder in one pass — skipping failures automatically.

Collages

From single photo to social-ready collage

Pick a layout or an occasion, then drag photos from your media bin onto each box. Vista fills the rest in.

Layouts & occasions

Pick a layout, or pick a moment

Browse grid layouts from a clean two-up to a busy six-photo mosaic, or jump straight to an occasion — birthday, anniversary, wedding, Raksha Bandhan, best wishes — each with its own ready-made arrangement and title.

  • 2–6 photo grid layouts
  • Occasion templates with titles built in
  • Double-click fills the next empty frame
Quick start

Sized right, before you've even started

Every quick-start template already knows the exact dimensions the platform expects — an Instagram post at 1080×1080, a YouTube thumbnail at 1280×720, a LinkedIn update at 1200×627, a Story at 1080×1920. Pick one and start dragging photos in.

  • Correct pixel dimensions for every platform
  • Photos stay in Media when you switch templates
  • Swap frames without rebuilding the layout
Export pack

Built for wherever you're posting

Every export target you actually need, with filename templating — and no EXIF data baked in.

Instagram Post
Instagram Story
YouTube Thumbnail
Pinterest

Plus PNG, JPEG and WebP export, carousel splitting, print-ready sizing, and CC0 music preview. MP4 export with audio is available in the Windows app.
